title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant required for a new and exciting permanent opportunity working for a well established business based in Tamworth. You will be working as part of a small friendly finance team and be responsible for the day to day running of the transactional finances for the business. Your duties will include purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, bank reconciliations, petty cash, expenses, journal entries and assisting with month end.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a junior finance assistant who is looking for a role where you can learn and develop. You must have excellent interpersonal skills and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other computerised accounting software. My client is offer an excellent benefits package including flexible working hours, hybrid working after probation, 20 days annual leave which increases with service, company pension, on site parking, study support and a lovely working culture so apply now!

title: Accounts Assistant - Stoke-on-Trent - &;30,000 + Hybrid Working
description:
A highly successful company is looking for an accomplished Accounts Assistant to join its team. Please note this role is hybrid - you'll work from home 2 days per week with 3 days in the office.

You'll have a broad range of transactional finance duties. These will include processing purchase invoices and supplier payments, reviewing the purchase ledger, preparing monthly creditor analysis, reconciling company credit cards and processing foreign supplier payments. You'll also liaise with suppliers to resolve queries, support VAT returns and maintain accurate financial records.

Working as part of the finance team, you'll play an important role in providing accurate, timely and meaningful financial information to support business decision-making. This is a role where attention to detail really matters, so you'll need to be organised, numerate and comfortable managing your own workload in a busy finance environment.

You'll have previous experience as an accounts assistant, purchase ledger or accounts payable professional, and have a good understanding of supplier invoice processing, reconciliations and payment runs. Good Excel skills and experience using accounting software is expected.

You'll be a proactive and personable finance professional who takes pride in getting things right and is confident investigating discrepancies and resolving supplier queries. This is a great opportunity for a capable Accounts Assistant, Purchase Ledger or Accounts Payable professional to broaden their experience, take greater ownership of an important area of finance and play a key role within a successful organisation.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on a 3-month fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven and organised individual who can hit the ground running and support the business in maintaining strong cash flow and reducing aged debt.

Based onsite in Cannock five days per week, you will play a key role in managing customer accounts, ensuring timely collections, and building effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively manage and collect outstanding debt across a portfolio of customer accounts.
- Contact customers by telephone and email to secure prompt payment.
- Investigate and resolve invoice queries and payment disputes efficiently.
- Produce and review aged debt reports, highlighting high-risk accounts.
- Allocate incoming payments and reconcile customer accounts.
- Maintain accurate records of all collection activity and customer communications.
- Work closely with sales, customer service, and finance teams to resolve issues impacting payment.
- Support month-end processes and reporting requirements.
- Ensure adherence to company credit control policies and procedures.

About You
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller, Accounts Receivable, or Collections position.
- Proven ability to manage and reduce aged debt.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Confident working with high volumes of customer accounts.
- Good attention to detail and accurate record-keeping skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and finance systems.
- Ability to work independently and prioritise workload effectively.
- Available to start immediately or at short notice.

Benefits
- Immediate start opportunity.
- Competitive salary of £30,000 equivalent pro rata.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Valuable experience within a fast-paced finance function.
- Free onsite parking.

Apply Now

title: Payroll Administrator
company: XPERT RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Administrator
Permanent
Monday - Thursday 8am - 4.15pm Friday 8am - 3pm
Stoke on Trent £28,000

We're looking for an organised and detail-focused Payroll Administrator to join a busy and supportive People & Culture team.

If you're someone who genuinely enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in getting the detail right and likes knowing that your work directly impacts people across the business, this could be a great opportunity for you.

You'll be responsible for supporting the smooth and accurate running of payroll, making sure employees are paid correctly and on time, whilst providing a reliable and professional service to colleagues and managers.

Key Responsibilities
Working alongside the Payroll Manager, you'll provide day-to-day administrative support across the payroll function.
From processing payroll information and maintaining employee records to dealing with queries, supporting pension administration and assisting with statutory payments, you'll play an important part in keeping everything running smoothly and meeting key payroll deadlines.
- Supporting the accurate and timely processing of payroll
- Ensuring payroll deadlines are consistently met
- Maintaining accurate employee payroll records, including starter and leaver information
- Processing payroll changes, deductions and other relevant information
- Assisting with holiday calculations and statutory payments
- Supporting pension administration
- Producing and completing payroll reports accurately and within required timescales
- Responding to payroll queries from employees and managers and resolving issues wherever possible
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with year-end activities and key payroll deadlines
- Keeping payroll systems and employee information accurate and up to date
- Staying informed of relevant payroll legislation and best practice
- Looking for opportunities to improve payroll processes and ways of working
- Ensuring all payroll information is handled with the highest level of confidentiality
- Working in line with company procedures and compliance requirements

Skills & Experience Required
- We're looking for someone who already has some hands-on payroll experience and is ready to build on that within a supportive team.
- You'll ideally have:
- Around 1-2 years' recent experience working within a payroll environment
- A good understanding of payroll processes and relevant legislation
- Experience using computerised payroll systems
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
- GCSE Maths and English (or equivalent) at Grade 4-9
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work
- The ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage your own workload
- A professional and approachable manner
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to deal with payroll queries
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a wider team
- A high level of discretion when handling confidential employee information

The benefits

You'll be joining a professional People & Culture team where you'll have the support and training you need to settle into the role and develop your knowledge.

The benefits package includes:
- Company pension, free pension advice and life insurance
- Healthcare Cash Plan
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Occupational Health Screening
- Health & Wellbeing Programme
- Enhanced annual leave
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
- Bereavement leave and company sick pay
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Discounted products
- Free on-site parking
- Employee referral scheme
- Long Service Awards
- Reward & Recognition Programme
- Company events
- Pre-retirement scheme
- Casual dress

If you're looking for a role where you can make a real impact behind the scenes and be part of a people-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply now or get in touch with Jo Thompson - for more information. Feel free to contact me directly with any questions about the role or the recruitment process.

Xpert Recruitment Ltd is acting as an employment agency on behalf of our client. By applying, you agree to register with us and consent to us holding your personal details on file. title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims on behalf of a number of Public Sector clients.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle a variety of casualty/personal injury claims through to settlement
- Verify policy cover/validity
- Log and record all claims digitally
- Investigate allocated claims either from desk or instructed by the team of loss adjusters
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Make decision on liability and negotiate settlement where appropriate
- Keep up to date with any technical changes within the industry and to your role which may involve participating in training programmes within the company

About you:
- Liability/Casualty Claims handling experience working in the Loss Adjusting, Insurance or Legal Sector
- Experience of handling your caseload of claims through to settlement
- The ability to value an injury loss
- Experience of handling defendant losses
- The ability or understand insurance policy wordings and the insurance market
- Knowledge of civil procedure rules and the claims portal
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Good planning and organisational skills
- Solid IT skills and be able to use multiple in-house systems
- Insurance Industry Qualifications or working towards desirable

Benefits on Offer:
- Remote or hybrid depending on location, 35 hours per week Monday to Friday
- Flexible benefits including holiday purchase plan and the opportunity to purchase health cash and BUPA dental plan, flexible working, 5% pension, life assurance 4 x, enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay, discounts with UK retailers, wellbeing hub and many more
